rows.title: ROBI: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (Q3 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 0.36 for July-September 2024 as against Tk. 0.20 for July-September 2023; Consolidated EPS was Tk. 0.77 for January-September 2024 as against Tk. 0.33 for January-September 2023. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 6.67 for January-September 2024 as against Tk. 5.47 for January-September 2023. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 12.51 as on September 30, 2024 and Tk. 12.76 as on December 31, 2023.

rows.title: ROBI: Regarding 20 MHz Spectrum acquisition from 2.6 GHz band
rows.body: The company has informed that it is going to procure 20 MHz additional Spectrum from 2.6 GHz band at a rate of BDT 580 million/MHz/15 years (exclusive of VAT/TAX) which will be effective from 1st July 2025. Robi will make the total payment in 8 equal instalments to acquire the spectrum and the 1st instalment payment to Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission ('BTRC') will be made on 31st October 2024 to confirm the acquisition.

rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended 15% Cash dividend for the year ended December 31, 2024. rows.title: ROBI: Receipt of PSP NOC by SmartPay Limited (a subsidiary of the company)
rows.body: The company has informed that SmartPay Limited, a fully owned subsidiary of Robi Axiata PLC., is a private company limited by shares incorporated under the Bangladesh Companies Act, 1994. The principal activity of SmartPay is to provide fintech-driven electronic payment services such as bill payments and other related services. Bangladesh Bank has issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) in favour of SmartPay Limited to operate as a Payment Service Provider (PSP).

rows.title: ROBI: Board approval regarding the launch of Cirkle as a new sub-brand
rows.body: The company has informed that the Board of Directors of Robi Axiata PLC approved the launch of "Cirkle" as a new sub-brand of the Company. The commercial use of the "Airtel" brand in connection with the relevant products and services will be discontinued as part of the transition. The launch of Cirkle or discontinuation of Airtel will have no impact on existing customers, products, services or customer arrangements.
